sn17.28:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || Lābhasakkārasiloko bhikkhave chaviṃ chindati || chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindati || cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindati || maṃsaṃ chetvā nahāruṃ chindati || nahāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindati || aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati || || Evaṃ dāruno kho bhikkhave lābhasakkarāsiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Aṭṭhamaṃ || ||
